svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception Class Reference

Detailed Description

This class is the foundation exception descriptor for DSI transactions.

It is intended to be used as-is by exception list and it can be base class for the users who need to provide specific error values through tests. The exceptions are errors that may be introduced into transactions, for the purpose of testing how the connected port of a DUT responds. The ultimate goal of this class is to describe an error on a DSI transaction in the following terms:

  • Which DSI packet is affected.
  • Which fields of DSI packet is(are) affected.

    This class contains all types of error flags and fields required for adding exceptions, which are injected in the DSI packet.

    To accomplish this, a top-down abstraction-driven approach is used to define the error. The error definition is based on the idea that errors may be classified based on the field affected or mechanism required for response behavior. This class defines basic errors which will affect the DSI packet. The types of errors are listed in dsi_packet_error_enum, dsi_packet_crc_error_position_type_enum, dsi_packet_ecc_error_position_type_enum. dsi_packet_payload_size_error_type_enum.

    When an object of this class is randomized, the error type out of dsi_packet_error_enum is selected first. Then if applicable, the corresponding error value is generated (based on constraints). Once these selections have been made.

    This class has built-in constraints to cause a randomized object of this type to select valid error kinds, values given a known configuration and transaction. However, it is understood that this may not meet all needs. As such, this class supports an additional mechanism for user extension. This has special meaning and effects, as follows:

  • Built-in constraints for tiered selection of error description property values can be bypassed. The user is responsible for implementing their own constraints, which should be conditional. Within the user's constraints, the ultimate goal should be to select a valid combination of error injection, as these properties determine the effect of the error injection.

    The instance of this class is used in exception list class. In turn, the instance of exception list shall be inside the DSI packet / sequence item. The exception list shall receive randomized exceptions from this class.

  • Once the affected field/bit of packet or type of error are selected, whether through the built-in constraints, or by the USER_DEFINED mechanism(Through testcase), the default (i.e. built-in) error injection mechanisms will be applied to the DSI packet.

    Error Injection

    If the particular error flag is set then the corresponding error shall be injected. this means When an error is defined, it must then be injected into a transaction based on the available transaction. In the VIP there are two mechanisms that make this happen, as described below.

    Transaction Object Error Injection - using methods in transactor

    For errors that do not require special handling, injection occurs by protocol driver/receiver modifying the contents of the transaction object itself. The VIP transactor then executes the transaction as it normally would, based on the contents of the transaction object. All errors possible are supported this way. However, for several special cases, the VIP transactor must interpret and apply the error. Those situations are described in the following section.

    Transactor Supported Error Injection - using special mechanism

    Some error types require special handling by the VIP transactors, because they cannot be expressed directly in the transaction object. In these cases, the transaction object is not modified, but the transaction, as executed by the VIP transactor, is. These cases are for error types are not in here: IMPORTANT If the user intends to take advantage of the user defined error capabilities of this class, it is important that the impact of the defined solving order is understood. The solve_order constraint block in this class specifies that the randomized variables be solved in the specific order: As a result of this enforced solution order, if the user wishes to specifically constrain a property at one level, they must make sure to constrain the properties at higher levels in the solve order to be consistent with the desired lower level result.

 bit [1:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::insert_data_type_err_in_pkt_hdr = 0

This variable is used to insert forward_data_id error in DSI-CPHY packet headers.
  • 0 : Indicates, error will be inserted in 1st Packet header.
  • 1 : Indicates, error will be inserted in 2nd Packet header.
  • 2 : Indicates, error will be injected in both the packet headers
  • 3 : Indicates, error will be injected randomly in any one or both the headers(case 0,1,2).
  • Default is 0 (First packet headers)

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::reasonable_err_bit_position

Constraint for err_bit_position field to generate single bit and multi bit ecc error.
constraint reasonable_err_bit_position {
     if(dsi_packet_error == ERR_ECC_SINGLE_BIT)
    {
      (err_bit_position[31:24] == 8'h0);
      (err_bit_position[0]+
       err_bit_position[1]+
       err_bit_position[2]+
       err_bit_position[3]+
       err_bit_position[4]+
       err_bit_position[5]+
       err_bit_position[6]+
       err_bit_position[7]+
       err_bit_position[8]+
       err_bit_position[9]+
       err_bit_position[10]+
       err_bit_position[11]+
       err_bit_position[12]+
       err_bit_position[13]+
       err_bit_position[14]+
       err_bit_position[15]+
       err_bit_position[16]+
       err_bit_position[17]+
       err_bit_position[18]+
       err_bit_position[19]+
       err_bit_position[20]+
       err_bit_position[21]+
       err_bit_position[22]+
       err_bit_position[23] == 24'h1);
    }
    else if(dsi_packet_error == ERR_ECC_MULTI_BIT)
    {
      if(ecc_error_position == DI){
        (err_bit_position[31:8] == 24'h0);
        (err_bit_position[0]+
         err_bit_position[1]+
         err_bit_position[2]+
         err_bit_position[3]+
         err_bit_position[4]+
         err_bit_position[5]+
         err_bit_position[6]+
         err_bit_position[7] == 8'h2);
      }
      else if(ecc_error_position == WC) {
        (err_bit_position[31:24] == 8'h0);
        (err_bit_position[7:0] == 8'h0);
        (err_bit_position[8]+
         err_bit_position[9]+
         err_bit_position[10]+
         err_bit_position[11]+
         err_bit_position[12]+
         err_bit_position[13]+
         err_bit_position[14]+
         err_bit_position[15]+
         err_bit_position[16]+
         err_bit_position[17]+
         err_bit_position[18]+
         err_bit_position[19]+
         err_bit_position[20]+
         err_bit_position[21]+
         err_bit_position[22]+
         err_bit_position[23] == 16'h2);
      }
      else if (ecc_error_position == ECC) {
        (err_bit_position[23:0] == 24'h0);
        (err_bit_position[31]+
         err_bit_position[30]+
         err_bit_position[29]+
         err_bit_position[28]+
         err_bit_position[27]+
         err_bit_position[26]+
         err_bit_position[25]+
         err_bit_position[24] == 8'h2);
      }
      else {
        (err_bit_position[31]+
         err_bit_position[30]+
         err_bit_position[29]+
         err_bit_position[28]+
         err_bit_position[27]+
         err_bit_position[26]+
         err_bit_position[25]+
         err_bit_position[24]+
         err_bit_position[8]+
         err_bit_position[9]+
         err_bit_position[10]+
         err_bit_position[11]+
         err_bit_position[12]+
         err_bit_position[13]+
         err_bit_position[14]+
         err_bit_position[15]+
         err_bit_position[16]+
         err_bit_position[17]+
         err_bit_position[18]+
         err_bit_position[19]+
         err_bit_position[20]+
         err_bit_position[21]+
         err_bit_position[22]+
         err_bit_position[23]+
         err_bit_position[0]+
         err_bit_position[1]+
         err_bit_position[2]+
         err_bit_position[3]+
         err_bit_position[4]+
         err_bit_position[5]+
         err_bit_position[6]+
         err_bit_position[7] == 8'h2);
      }
    }
  else if(dsi_packet_error == ERR_ECC_MORE_THAN_TWO_BITS)
    {
      if(ecc_error_position == DI){
        (err_bit_position[31:8] == 24'h0);
        ((err_bit_position[0]+
         err_bit_position[1]+
         err_bit_position[2]+
         err_bit_position[3]+
         err_bit_position[4]+
         err_bit_position[5]+
         err_bit_position[6]+
         err_bit_position[7]) inside {[8'h3:8'h8]});
      }
      else if(ecc_error_position == WC) {
        (err_bit_position[31:24] == 8'h0);
        (err_bit_position[7:0] == 8'h0);
        ((err_bit_position[8]+
         err_bit_position[9]+
         err_bit_position[10]+
         err_bit_position[11]+
         err_bit_position[12]+
         err_bit_position[13]+
         err_bit_position[14]+
         err_bit_position[15]+
         err_bit_position[16]+
         err_bit_position[17]+
         err_bit_position[18]+
         err_bit_position[19]+
         err_bit_position[20]+
         err_bit_position[21]+
         err_bit_position[22]+
         err_bit_position[23]) inside {[16'h3:16'h10]});
      }
      else if (ecc_error_position == ECC) {
        (err_bit_position[23:0] == 24'h0);
        ((err_bit_position[31]+
         err_bit_position[30]+
         err_bit_position[29]+
         err_bit_position[28]+
         err_bit_position[27]+
         err_bit_position[26]+
         err_bit_position[25]+
         err_bit_position[24]) inside {[8'h3:8'h8]});
      }
      else {
        ((err_bit_position[31]+
         err_bit_position[30]+
         err_bit_position[29]+
         err_bit_position[28]+
         err_bit_position[27]+
         err_bit_position[26]+
         err_bit_position[25]+
         err_bit_position[24]+
         err_bit_position[8]+
         err_bit_position[9]+
         err_bit_position[10]+
         err_bit_position[11]+
         err_bit_position[12]+
         err_bit_position[13]+
         err_bit_position[14]+
         err_bit_position[15]+
         err_bit_position[16]+
         err_bit_position[17]+
         err_bit_position[18]+
         err_bit_position[19]+
         err_bit_position[20]+
         err_bit_position[21]+
         err_bit_position[22]+
         err_bit_position[23]+
         err_bit_position[0]+
         err_bit_position[1]+
         err_bit_position[2]+
         err_bit_position[3]+
         err_bit_position[4]+
         err_bit_position[5]+
         err_bit_position[6]+
         err_bit_position[7]) inside {[32'h3:32'h31]});
      }
    }
     else
    {
      err_bit_position == 0;
    }
   }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::reasonable_err_vc_id_value

If the supported vc id is 4'hf DSI packet randomization can generate any vc id value between 0-3. With this value of supported vc id the exception class cannot generate value that 2'b11 so that any value generated by packet for vc id should be ex-ored by this value to inject vc id error and in this case both the bits of vc id will be changed.
constraint reasonable_err_vc_id_value {
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h1) -> (err_vc_id_value != 2'b00);
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h2) -> (err_vc_id_value != 2'b01);
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h3) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b00,2'b01});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h4) -> (err_vc_id_value != 2'b10);
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h5) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b00,2'b10});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h6) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b01,2'b10});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h7) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b00,2'b01,2'b10});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h8) -> (err_vc_id_value != 2'b11);
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'h9) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b00,2'b11});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hA) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b01,2'b11});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hB) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b00,2'b01,2'b11});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hC) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b10,2'b11});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hD) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b00,2'b10,2'b11});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hE) -> !(err_vc_id_value inside {2'b01,2'b10,2'b11});
      ((sys_cfg.supported_vc_id) == 4'hF) -> (err_vc_id_value == 2'b11);
  }

 svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::solve_order

Constraint to set the solving order.
constraint solve_order {
    solve dsi_packet_error before ecc_error_position;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::valid_ranges

Valid constraints.
constraint valid_ranges {
    if(sys_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration:: CPHY)
    {
      dsi_packet_error inside {ERR_ECC_SINGLE_BIT, ERR_ECC_MULTI_BIT,ERR_ECC_MORE_THAN_TWO_BITS,
                               ERR_VC_ID, ERR_DT, ERR_WC, ERR_CRC,ERR_PAYLOAD_SIZE,ERR_PKT_HDR_SIZE,
                               ERR_PKT_BYTE_COUNT,ERR_NO_HS_SOT_EOT_ON_LANE, ERR_NO_ULPS_ON_LANE,
                               ERR_PH_CRC,ERR_SSDC_VALUE,ERR_FILLER_VALUE,ERR_LPDT_ON_ALL_LANES,ERR_NONE};
    }
    else
    {
      dsi_packet_error inside {ERR_ECC_SINGLE_BIT, ERR_ECC_MULTI_BIT,ERR_ECC_MORE_THAN_TWO_BITS,
                               ERR_VC_ID, ERR_DT, ERR_WC, ERR_CRC, ERR_ACK_WITH_ERR_RESP,
                               ERR_EOTP_PACKET, ERR_HS_TRAIL_BYTES,ERR_PAYLOAD_SIZE,ERR_NONE
      };
    }
     if(sys_cfg.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration:: CPHY)
    {
      no_sot_eot_on_lane_num inside {[1: 4]};
      no_ulps_on_lane_num inside {[1: 4]};
      no_sot_eot_on_lane_num != 0;
      no_ulps_on_lane_num != 0;
      err_filler_value != 8'h00;
      err_ssdc_value != 12'h888;
    }
  }
